summary: Companhia Siderúrgica Nacional (CSN) announced a private exchange offer and consent solicitation by its wholly-owned subsidiary, CSN Inova Ventures, to exchange all $1.3 billion of its 6.750% Senior Notes due 2028 for new 11.000% Senior Notes due 2030 plus cash. Per $1,000 principal, holders receive $746.15 in new notes and $253.85 cash, with a step-down provision reducing the new note rate by 50bps if principal is reduced by $200M before February 2028. The exchange is available to eligible qualified institutional buyers and offshore holders under Rule 144A/Regulation S. Consents are required to amend the indenture. The offer aims to restructure near-term debt, with the spread to 2030 maturities and rate step-down as key watch items.
